traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 species aggregate for Abies grandis (gwddagg_v2.2_species.csv, read): specific gravity 0.37 (wsg_est, the database's hierarchical-model species mean, from 6 records in 6 sources); trunks 0.36, branches 0.45. Basic density (oven-dry mass over green volume) is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.juvenile_period_years.note: FEIS (Howard and Aleksoff 2000, read): cone and seed production begins at 20 to 50 years of age. The Woody Plant Seed Manual (Abies, table 3, read) gives 20 as the minimum age for commercial seed bearing in northern Idaho. It sets adult_age through the rule at the seed plants (spec rework P6), in place of the 20 years set by hand.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tall fir with a narrow, domed crown, level branches and flat sprays of long, glossy needles in two ranks. Not fitted to measurements. Cones (plant forms F3): 6 to 11 cm stand upright on the top branches and shed their scales on the tree; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 33 m tall and 50 cm across at breast height at 60 years in a closed stand. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: glossy dark green needles; smooth grey bark with resin blisters, furrowed with age. Needle shoots (plant roadmap P4): flat needles 2 to 5 cm long and about 2 mm wide, so a needle 0.065 as wide as it is long (`width`), from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): smooth and grey with resin blisters when young, then furrowed into flat grey-brown ridges; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).
